lines: Even memories cannot last for eternity,
and cried in a corner of my heart.
And please, do not lose it,
the passing days beneath the overpass.
That day I failed to say so.
There were times we were connected.
We brought together our unravelling feelings.
And I just lost that too.
Even forms change as time passes,
And please, do not lose it,
the passing days beneath the overpass.
That day I failed to say so.
I keep scratching myself today too,
leaving wounds I will not forget.
